title: ACVFA and Dis/Misinformation
description:
Hi Sophia,
I'm happy to do either a 1 pager on disinfo, give you topics for the public fora, or fill out the survey. What works best?
cheers, vera

relationships.evidence:
[opaque block] Google Vault - ACVFA & dis/misinformation
As you saw there was clearly a lot of interest on the issue of dis/misinformation. This will likely be a
main issue the committee works on (likely a smaller subgroup of members would focus on it), and l'd
love to set some time to hear your thoughts on this as well as your reactions to the meeting in
general. I am also restructuring our workplan proposal based on Friday's convo.
1 am also adding +Vera Zakem here following the Administrator's note in a recent DWW (attached)
regarding a potential presentation on the Information Resilience Council at the next ACVFA meeting.
Would love to discuss this and the IRC in general, potential opportunities for collaboration/support,
etc.
Let me know which days might work best this week or next and happy to send a calendar invite.
Please also of course add anyone else who should join. Also including +Donald Steinberg +Jodi
Herman lead advisors for ACVFA.
Thanks all very much!
Sophia
Sophia Lajaunie (she/her/hers)
Executive Director of the Advisory Committeeon Voluntary Foreign Aid (ACVFA)
Public Engagement Advisor
Bureau for Legislative & Public Affairs
U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID)
Johnny Walsh

U.S. Agency for International Development
Vera Zakem

USAID

Thank you Vera. Our priority for now is to ensure that the questions in this survey for ACVFA members reflect the
DRG/AC priorities/challenges that we'd like the committee to work on, if you're able to take a look and ensure they reflect
that. That way we can send it back out to members to get them engaged on it.
Separately, yes, would love both the 1 pager on disinfo and suggested topics for the public meeting whenever you get the
chance! Thanks very much.
And thank you Shannon for your edits to the working group questions!
